mapper.select: SELECT b.book_id, b.title, bd.isbn, bd.publisher, r.review_id, r.content, r.rating FROM book b LEFT JOIN book_detail bd ON b.book_id = bd.book_id LEFT JOIN review r ON b.book_id = r.book_id
SELECT b.book_id, b.title, bd.isbn, bd.publisher FROM book as b LEFT JOIN book_detail as bd ON b.book_id = bd.book_id WHERE b.book_id = #{bookId}
